definitions.explanation: in photography, the amount of light allowed to reach the camera sensor or film

definitions.gloss: exposure; revealing (of skin or body parts)
definitions.explanation: showing or revealing parts of the body, typically in fashion or media contexts

examples.japanese: {露出|ろしゅつ}を{調整|ちょうせい}する。
{露出|ろしゅつ}{不足|ぶそく}で{写真|しゃしん}が{暗|くら}くなった。
examples.english: The photo came out dark due to underexposure.

examples.japanese: カメラの{露出|ろしゅつ}を{自動|じどう}に{設定|せってい}する。
examples.english: To set the camera exposure to automatic.

examples.japanese: {露出|ろしゅつ}の{多|おお}い{服|ふく}を{着|き}る。
{夏|なつ}は{露出|ろしゅつ}が{増|ふ}える。
examples.english: People show more skin in summer.

examples.japanese: メディアへの{露出|ろしゅつ}が{増|ふ}えた。

notes:
{露出|ろしゅつ} has several meanings related to exposure or revealing.

PHOTOGRAPHY:
- {露出|ろしゅつ}{補正|ほせい}: exposure compensation
- {露出|ろしゅつ}{計|けい}: light meter
- {適正|てきせい}{露出|ろしゅつ}: correct exposure
- {露出|ろしゅつ}{不足|ぶそく}: underexposure
- {露出|ろしゅつ}{過多|かた}: overexposure

MEDIA/FASHION:
- {露出|ろしゅつ}が{多|おお}い: revealing (clothing)
- メディア{露出|ろしゅつ}: media exposure

VERBAL FORM:
{露出|ろしゅつ}する: to expose, to be exposed
